tool_plan.objective: Generate representative Chrome cache content and preserve the Chrome Cache_Data source for ChromeCacheView listing, metadata review, preview, export, and cache-file extraction testing.

required_actions.name: browser.launch
required_actions.why: Creates a Chromium session and profile that can produce Chrome cache data.

required_actions.name: browser.goto
required_actions.why: Loads distinct web documents that create cache entries and URL metadata.

required_actions.name: browser.get_clickables
required_actions.why: Observes available page controls before exercising cache-generating interactions.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_type
required_actions.why: Supplies realistic search or form input that can produce parameterized cached responses.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_click
required_actions.why: Exercises visible links or primary page interactions that load additional cacheable resources.

required_actions.name: browser.click
required_actions.why: Commits an observed control when a specific visible interaction is needed.

required_actions.name: browser.select_option
required_actions.why: Varies an observed finite page parameter that may produce materially different cached content.

required_actions.name: browser.scroll
required_actions.why: Reveals lazy-loaded or progressively loaded resources for additional cache entries.

required_actions.name: browser.screenshot
required_actions.why: Captures the visible representation associated with the browsing state that generated cached content.

required_actions.name: browser.close
required_actions.why: Closes the session so pending Chrome cache writes can be finalized before collection.

completion.detail: Complete after the Chromium session has been closed and the Chrome Cache_Data source is present for collection.

tool_plan.action_intent_guidance: Action Flow: Launch Chromium, then use relevant run-provided runtime resources with browser.goto to load a few distinct, naturally cacheable pages. On pages with visible controls, use browser.get_clickables before interaction. Use browser.smart_type for an available search or form field, then browser.smart_click or browser.click on observed visible controls to load result, detail, or related content. Where an observed finite selector is available, use browser.select_option to request a materially different page state. Use browser.scroll to reveal lazy or progressively loaded visible resources, then re-run browser.get_clickables after each bounded reveal when further visible controls may be available. Capture browser.screenshot for representative generated states. These navigations, parameterized responses, linked content, and loaded media/resources populate chromium.cache.cache_data with cache entries and URL metadata. Close the browser with browser.close after activity so cache writes can finalize.
